name: techswifttrix-erp
description: TechSwiftTrix ERP System - Multi-tenant Enterprise Resource Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c bgBlue.bold,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.build:ceo: npm run build:ceo --workspace=frontend && node scripts/netlify-sync-portal-build.mjs ceo
scripts.build:executive: npm run build:executive --workspace=frontend && node scripts/netlify-sync-portal-build.mjs executive
scripts.build:clevel: npm run build:clevel --workspace=frontend && node scripts/netlify-sync-portal-build.mjs clevel
scripts.build:operations: npm run build:operations --workspace=frontend && node scripts/netlify-sync-portal-build.mjs operations
scripts.build:technology: npm run build:technology --workspace=frontend && node scripts/netlify-sync-portal-build.mjs technology
scripts.build:agents: npm run build:agents --workspace=frontend && node scripts/netlify-sync-portal-build.mjs agents
scripts.build:trainers: npm run build:trainers --workspace=frontend && node scripts/netlify-sync-portal-build.mjs trainers
scripts.deploy:ceo: npm run build:ceo && node scripts/netlify-deploy-portal.mjs ceo
scripts.deploy:executive: npm run build:executive && node scripts/netlify-deploy-portal.mjs executive
scripts.deploy:clevel: npm run build:clevel && node scripts/netlify-deploy-portal.mjs clevel
scripts.deploy:operations: npm run build:operations && node scripts/netlify-deploy-portal.mjs operations
scripts.deploy:technology: npm run build:technology && node scripts/netlify-deploy-portal.mjs technology
scripts.deploy:agents: npm run build:agents && node scripts/netlify-deploy-portal.mjs agents
scripts.deploy:trainers: npm run build:trainers && node scripts/netlify-deploy-portal.mjs trainers
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit -p backend/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json
